scope.note: Counts cover the exposed API tree, including locally hidden or clipped nodes. Hidden instance children can be omitted. Source instances are not DOM counts or viewport-visible counts. findings.summary: Existing guidance explicitly keeps the indicator static, while the new example annotation requests a gradient flowing along the header bottom during AI thinking. Add a scoped processing-state motion contract without inventing duration/easing/direction/loop or treating325px as progress percent.

No current contract covers the assistant thinking row: existing BrandMark32 + gap8 + gradient14/20 text with elapsed sample. It is not a UserMessage, interrupted ProgressAlert, Spinner or output renderer. Define the composition and product-owned lifecycle/readable status separately.

motionInterpretation.note: Empty motion data does not erase the written design intent. It prevents a claim of measured keyframes/timing. Static gradient text or a static PNG does not by itself imply shimmer or rotation.

status.note: FRAME composition:32px existing BrandMark +8px gap +96px HUG text, vertically centered. No root COMPONENT/INSTANCE, exposed state variant or product API is provided.

brandMark.visualComparison: Isolated32px screenshot and existing original mark show the same multicolor shape. Matching original imageHash/local SHA1 and all PNG chunks/CRC is stronger than a visual similarity claim.
brandMark.usageContract: Existing BrandMark permits ratio-preserving smaller presentation. Keep the original static RGBA PNG and zero image filters; placing it inside a processing status does not add rotation or new animation to BrandMark globally.

text.note: Identity gradientTransform and5stops are static paint evidence. Opacity.69 belongs to the TEXT node; all stop alphas are1. The final black stop at.9149797559 continues to the edge. Sample4seconds is not a timer interval or initial state contract.

motionBoundary.sourceImageBytes: StaticPNG; no GIF header or APNG acTL/fcTL/fdAT chunks.
motionBoundary.staticPaint: TEXT gradient and sample elapsed label are measured; neither defines time-varying animation.
motionBoundary.designAnnotation: Red note specifically requests a gradient moving along the Header bottom line while AI thinks. It is design intent for the header, not evidence that BrandMark rotates or the status image is an animated GIF.
motionBoundary.timelineOrReactionTiming: Parent task owns additional motion queries; this review does not infer duration/easing/loop from empty reactions or static screenshot.
motionBoundary.productOwned: Request/thinking state, elapsed-time origin/update/format, stream lifecycle and reduced-motion/readable status behavior need an explicit consuming-product contract. No implementation is claimed.

recommendations: Reuse assets/brand/agent-hub-mark.png unchanged at32×32; no new PNG download or icon redraw is needed.

Document the thinking-status FRAME as a composition/optional reusable contract with BrandMark dependency, live product-owned status label and local gradient text style. Keep ProgressAlert as its existing interrupted-response contract.

Preserve exact static text gradient stops/transform/opacity/font while treating any shimmer or header animation as separately sourced motion. Do not add image spin or hardcoded4second timer from this sample.
Exclude visible red annotation nodes3016:118112/113 from product DOM and asset mapping. Keep their instruction as design evidence only.
